===============================================================
  [MAP NAME] - INSTALLATION AND ACTIVATION
===============================================================

Thank you for your purchase!

This map is unlocked with a personal activation code. You enter
the code once, and the map stays unlocked for your Minecraft
account from then on.

Please read the "KEEP YOUR CODE" section below before you start.


---------------------------------------------------------------
  WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE
---------------------------------------------------------------

  1. This instruction file
  2. The map folder
  3. map-license-x.y.z.jar      (the mod that unlocks the map)
  4. Your activation code       -->  [YOUR CODE HERE]

If any of these is missing, contact [SUPPORT CONTACT] before
going further.


---------------------------------------------------------------
  WHAT YOU NEED
---------------------------------------------------------------

  * Minecraft: Java Edition, version 1.21.11
  * Fabric Loader 0.16 or newer
        https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/
  * Fabric API for 1.21.11
        https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api

Fabric is a free mod loader. The installer takes about a minute
and adds a new profile to your Minecraft launcher. This map does
not work on Bedrock Edition, Realms, or the Marketplace.


---------------------------------------------------------------
  INSTALLING
---------------------------------------------------------------

Step 1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.11 using the
        link above, then start the Minecraft launcher once and
        select the new "fabric-loader-1.21.11" profile.

Step 2. Open your Minecraft folder.

        Windows   Press Win+R, type  %appdata%\.minecraft
        macOS     ~/Library/Application Support/minecraft
        Linux     ~/.minecraft

Step 3. Put BOTH of these files into the "mods" folder.
        Create the folder if it is not there yet.

           - map-license-x.y.z.jar     (included with your purchase)
           - fabric-api-....jar        (downloaded from the link above)

Step 4. Put the map folder into the "saves" folder, next to your
        other worlds.

Step 5. Start Minecraft using the Fabric profile, and open the
        map from your singleplayer world list.

IMPORTANT: If you were sent more than one map-license jar, keep
only the one with the HIGHEST version number and delete the rest.
Older versions do not recognise newer codes.


---------------------------------------------------------------
  ACTIVATING
---------------------------------------------------------------

When you enter the world, a code window opens by itself.

  1. Type your activation code.
  2. Press Enter, or click Activate.
  3. When it says the map is activated, the window closes and
     you can play.

That is it. The window will not appear again on this computer.

You do not have to be careful about how you type the code.
Capitals, lowercase, hyphens and spaces all work the same, and
the letters I, l and O are read as the digits 1 and 0. Any of
these are the same code:

        ABCD-EFGH-JKMN-PQRS
        abcd efgh jkmn pqrs
        ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRS

While the window is open your character cannot move, break or
place blocks, or use items. Nothing can hurt you during this
time. If you do not enter a code within 5 minutes you will be
disconnected - simply rejoin and enter it then.

If the window does not appear (this can happen on a multiplayer
server), open the chat and type:

        /maplicense activate YOUR-CODE-HERE


---------------------------------------------------------------
  KEEP YOUR CODE
---------------------------------------------------------------

Save your code somewhere safe, even after you have activated.

You will need it again if you:

  * reinstall Minecraft or your operating system
  * move to a different computer
  * delete the "config" folder in your Minecraft directory

Treat the code like a password. Anyone who has it can use it,
so please do not post it publicly or send it to other people.
It cannot be replaced if it is given away.


---------------------------------------------------------------
  IF SOMETHING GOES WRONG
---------------------------------------------------------------

"That code is not valid"
        Check for typos first. If you gave a Minecraft username
        when you bought the map, your code only works on THAT
        account - make sure you are logged into it. If both are
        correct, your copy of the mod may be older than your
        code, so ask [SUPPORT CONTACT] for the latest jar.

"That code has already been used"
        This code has already been activated on this computer.
        If that was not you, contact [SUPPORT CONTACT].

"Your account already owns this map"
        Good news - you are already unlocked. Just play.

"Too many attempts"
        You entered ten wrong codes, or typed them too quickly.
        Leave the world and rejoin to reset it.

"No activation code was entered"
        The five minute timer ran out. Rejoin and try again.

The code window never appears
        Check that the map-license jar and Fabric API are both
        in your "mods" folder, and that you launched Minecraft
        with the Fabric profile rather than the normal one.

The world opens but the story never starts
        The mod is probably not loaded. See the point above -
        the map needs the mod to run, not just to unlock.

The game crashes on startup
        Almost always a version mismatch. Confirm all three:
        Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader 0.16+, and a Fabric API
        build for 1.21.11.

Still stuck? Contact [SUPPORT CONTACT] and include your
Minecraft username and the exact message you are seeing.


---------------------------------------------------------------
  A NOTE ON SHARING
---------------------------------------------------------------

This map took a long time to build. Copying the files is easy,
but every code is issued once and tied to the account that used
it. Please do not redistribute the map, the mod, or your code.
